text: Entry 1510 introduces an OAuth2Module-only browser test. It observes the auth window, presses Escape or changes the submitted scope, asserts NS_ERROR_ABORT, checks the matching telemetry result and verifies that no login token was saved. This isolates authorization-window outcomes from account setup and mail connection failures. The pointer and Escape test code was inspected but not executed. Static source and test-code inspection only. Full Bugzilla and Phabricator timeline and inline discussion remains pending. No runtime or live accessibility result is claimed.
title: Exercise OAuth cancellation and invalid scopes without creating a mail account
